scripts.build: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.test:gateway: node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs gateway/jwt.test.mjs && node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs gateway/membership.test.mjs && node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs gateway/gameActions.test.mjs && node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs gateway/jamSync.test.mjs
scripts.db:reset: supabase db reset && npm run db:seed:users
scripts.db:seed:users: node --env-file=.env.local scripts/seed-local-users.mjs && docker exec -i $(docker ps -qf name=supabase_db) psql -U postgres -d postgres < scripts/seed-local-memberships.sql
scripts.test:gateway:offline: node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs gateway/jwt.test.mjs && node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs gateway/gameActions.test.mjs && node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs gateway/jamSync.test.mjs
